design_philosophy.identity: The Red Carpet of Real Estate

usage_rules: Headings (H1, H2): Use Montserrat Bold/Black. Tight tracking (-0.02em).
Subheadings (H3, H4): Use Montserrat SemiBold. Normal tracking.
Body Text: Use Inter. Relaxed line-height (1.6).
Labels/Overlines: Uppercase, wide tracking (0.1em), small size (12px).

usage.primary: Main CTAs, Active States, Brand Highlights (Use sparingly for impact)
usage.surface: Cards, Modals (White or very light gray)

rules: Avoid uniform rows of equal-sized cards.
Use col-span-8 for hero listings, col-span-4 for secondary.

buttons.primary: bg-[#C8102E] text-white hover:bg-[#A00C24] rounded-sm px-8 py-3 font-semibold transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: border-2 border-[#0D0D0D] text-[#0D0D0D] hover:bg-[#0D0D0D] hover:text-white rounded-sm px-8 py-3 font-semibold transition-all

cards.property_card: bg-white rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-gray-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 group
cards.feature_card: p-8 bg-gray-50 hover:bg-white border border-transparent hover:border-gray-200 transition-all

navigation.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-gray-100

motion.micro_interactions: Active states should have immediate feedback (scale 0.98 on click)

hero_section.description: Primary Hero Image. Full width, immersive.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic 'SaaS Blue'. Stick to the Red/Black/White theme.
Avoid gradients on text. Keep it legible and high-contrast.
Images must be optimized and lazy-loaded.
Do not center-align long text blocks. Left-align for readability.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the frontend for ANK Realty. Use the provided colors and typography strictly. Implement the 'Bento Grid' layout for property listings. Use the provided image URLs for the respective sections. Ensure the 'Post Property' form is a multi-step wizard using Shadcn Form components. The dashboard should be clean and data-focused.
